baseline.stdout:
Analyze languages in a Git revision, or profile a plain directory without Git. With no subcommand, emit the github-linguist directory output format. Git repositories use committed HEAD content by default; --source directory scans current files.

Usage:
  dircue [path] [flags]
  dircue [command]

Available Commands:
  analyze     Run a selected profiler
  help        Help about any command

Flags:
  -b, --breakdown            Include file paths in language results
  -h, --help                 help for dircue
  -j, --json                 Emit JSON
      --max-file-bytes int   Skip files larger than this many bytes (0 disables the optional size limit)
  -r, --rev string           Git revision to analyze (default "HEAD")
      --source string        Content source: auto (Git when present), git, or directory (default "auto")
  -s, --strategies           Show the language detection strategy for each file (text output)
  -t, --tree-size int        Maximum number of files scanned (default 100000)
  -v, --version              version for dircue
      --workers int          Number of concurrent file workers (0 selects automatically)

Use "dircue [command] --help" for more information about a command.
